title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas equations and case-Re constant viscosity are implemented; numerical outcomes limit validation.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS mixed-cell geometry, boundary families and adjacency implemented; local contour/force evidence varies by case.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Conservative limited reconstructed face residual and BCs present; M2 laminar force drift shows residual criterion alone is insufficient.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov is used in production; Roe routine exists but report states production does not use it. Historical flux test passes.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip/no-slip wall treatment and boundary-value output exist; numerical laminar outcomes remain weak.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp invokes LSQ reconstruction with limited gradients; historical gradient test passes; no independent production order study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter and positivity treatment are active; historical limiter test passes, but production fallback frequency unverified.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Viscous flux and wall gradient exist, but forces.cpp:95–99 integrates full traction rather than tangential-only shear and laminar drag is excessive.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: CFL ramp and LU-SGS sweeps exist; M2 laminar reaches nominal residual gate while Cd still falls 59% over last50 steps.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 dual-time structure exists; finished Re200 records 29180/30000 inner-target misses and no resolved shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and local halos/rank tests exist, but full global raw/geometric mesh persists on every rank.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
